Xmla.pickConnection: Select a connection to load the metadata

Hints.cube: The cube the query reads from, inside the catalogue the connection names.
Hints.pollingEnabled: Whether this source re-reads on its own.
Hints.pollingInterval: How often it re-reads, in milliseconds.
Hints.useVisualEditor: Whether the query is put together in the designer rather than written as MDX.
Hints.mdx: The query in MDX, if you write it yourself.
Hints.useMdx: Whether the written MDX is sent instead of the query built in the designer.
